verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, SDK pagination, rule actions, and an MCP server for creating and searching tasks. None of it describes a bulk or batch operation that acts on many items at once, such as a batch endpoint or multi-select bulk edit. Pagination and natural-language search are read or adjacent capabilities, and composing many single-item API calls is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
